title: Melbourne Parking Occupancy — occupancy_YYYY-MM.parquet
description: One row per kerbside zone per 30-minute slot. Derived from City of Melbourne On-street Parking Bay Sensors (CC BY 4.0), which publishes current per-bay status only.

time.description: Start of the half-hour slot, UTC. Rows collected before 2026-11-12 carry the moment of collection and drift a few seconds inside the slot; from 2026-11-12 the collector snaps to the grid. Floor to 30 minutes for an exact grid.

parking_id.description: Zone key. Joins to parking_zones.id. Not the city's own number — that is parking_zones.zone_id.

free_spaces.description: Bays reported unoccupied in the zone at that moment. Exceeds parking_zones.bays in 696 rows (0.05%, 120 zones) because the bay count is today's value while the row is from the day it was collected.

occupancy_rate.description: Percent of the zone's bays occupied. Computed by the collector as the share of occupied sensors; the city does not publish a rate. Stays within 0-100 across all 1,413,875 rows. Exactly 0 in 17.5% of rows and exactly 100 in 9.7%: the median zone has 7 bays, so both ends are hit often.
